embed.name: CodFlow — Cash on Delivery
embed.intro: Turn this on to enable cash-on-delivery ordering across your store. Button text and colours are configured in the CodFlow app, not here — this section only controls how the button fits your theme.

sticky_mobile.label: Sticky button on mobile
sticky_mobile.info: Keeps a cash-on-delivery button fixed to the bottom of the screen on phones.

floating.label: Floating button
floating.info: Shows a button that follows the shopper as they scroll. Its corner and offset are set in the CodFlow app.

anchor.label: Button anchor (CSS selector)
anchor.info: Leave empty unless CodFlow's buttons land in the wrong place on your theme. When set, buttons are inserted next to the first element matching this selector.

hide_native.label: Buy button selector (CSS)
hide_native.info: Leave empty for most themes. Only set this if CodFlow fails to hide your theme's Add to cart button — an incorrect selector here can hide the wrong element.

block.name: CodFlow — COD button
block.intro: Places a cash-on-delivery button here. Its text and colours come from your CodFlow settings.

placement.label: Placement
placement.info: Tells CodFlow which of your configured buttons to show here.

reserved_height.label: Reserved height
reserved_height.info: Space held for the button while it loads. Set this close to your button's real height to avoid the page shifting.
